messages:
adie.procure: Vendor Q sent pilot quote + invoice. Two quick flags: (1) they applied a "platform onboarding" charge we never approved, (2) pilot credits say "apply to future invoices only" and explicitly exclude commit count. Can finance/billing advise?

noah.finance: if credits don't count toward committed tiering that's a problem for our economics. also onboarding charges for pilot should be zero per our procurement policy. Please paste the invoice snippet.

adie.procure: snippet:
```
Invoice #9012
- Pilot ingest (GB): 800 @ $0.02 = $16.00
- Event processing (10k): 40 @ $5.50 = $220.00
- Platform onboarding: $2,000.00
- Pilot credit: -$1,000.00
Net due: $1,236.00
```
They attached contract language: "Pilot credits are non-applicable to committed spend and will be applied as invoice reductions only."

ben.billing: onboarding shouldn't be billed unless we signed an SOW. Ask vendor for credit or corrected invoice. For credits, we need them to be convertible into year-1 commit or at least 75% countable for tiering. Otherwise unit economics are funky.

rachel.sales: i'll push vendor for conversion to commit with amendment. Our negotiation play: remove onboarding fee or convert it into credits that count for tiering, and allow up to 75% of pilot credits to apply to first-year commit if amendment signed within 30 days.

noah.finance: also request a clear sample invoice showing how conversion would appear (credit memo or prepayment). Add audit right to verify pilot usage logs.

adie.procure: agreed. i'll message vendor: 1) waive onboarding for pilot or convert into credits; 2) amend credits clause to allow 75% conversion toward year-1 commit upon signed amendment within 30 days; 3) vendor must provide raw usage CSV and an example credit memo. Holding payment until they issue corrected invoice that removes onboarding or documents conversion.

vendorbot: Vendor Q uploaded revised invoice draft: https://vendorq.example.com/invoice/9012/draft (v1.1)

ben.billing: once we get the corrected invoice and CSV, i'll run line-by-line and propose releasing 90% of undisputed amount now, hold disputed remainder.

rachel.sales: i'll escalate with rep for the amendment language. if they refuse 75% we accept 60% + SLA credits.

adie.procure: perfect. tagging @noah.finance and @ben.billing for final sign-off on hold/PO. I'll update the PR to block payment until invoice corrected.

noah.finance: ok to hold per our dispute playbook. will review vendor draft and reply by EOD.

adie.procure: thanks all — i'll paste vendor reply when it comes in."
